name: Hirschau (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and blue, charged above the centre with the city arms of Hirschau (a white stag on red).
history: Municipal flag of Hirschau; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Hirschau arms — white stag on red
